name: Yukemuri☆Adventure!?
original_name: 湯けむり☆あどべんちゃ～！？
source: This is the VN game included in the special edition of vol. 6 of the manga Koe de Oshigoto!, inspired in the hot springs chapter featured in that volume, which is #32 in the series.
translation: 这是漫画《声之工作！》第6卷特别版附带的视觉小说，灵感来自该卷收录的温泉篇，也就是全系列第32话。
